_comment: Checks known to fail at v6.7.0 and scheduled for Phase 1 of docs/STEALTH_REVIEW_2026-09.md. CI reports them but does not fail on them. A check NOT listed here that fails is a regression and fails the build. Remove an id from this list the moment Phase 1 fixes it.
_seeded: Corrected from the first real run (2026-09-21, macOS arm64, Chromium 151.0.7922.34 + Camoufox 135.0.1-beta.24, Playwright 1.62.1) — see docs/stealth-bench-baseline-2026-09-21-residential.md. Two seeded ids were dropped because the run showed them passing: worker-useragent (the spoofed UA does reach the worker) and webrtc-host-candidates (host candidates are mDNS .local only; the real-IP leak the review saw on CreepJS came through a STUN server, which this check deliberately does not use so it stays deterministic in CI). Every remaining id was observed failing. The list is deliberately engine- and platform-independent: an id is listed if it fails on either engine, because a pass/fail baseline captured on macOS would not hold on Linux CI.

_findings.navigator-webdriver: chromium: the property is deleted, not false (observed 2026-09-21; review finding 9). camoufox passes.
_findings.useragentdata-brands: chromium: brands are Not=A?Brand 99, HeadlessChrome 151, Chromium 151 — no "Google Chrome" brand (observed 2026-09-21).
_findings.worker-platform: chromium: worker reports the real "MacIntel" against a spoofed main thread (observed 2026-09-21). camoufox passes.
_findings.worker-hardware-concurrency: chromium: worker reports the real core count against the spoofed main thread (observed 2026-09-21). camoufox passes.
_findings.worker-languages: both engines, in opposite directions: chromium worker "en-US" vs main "en-US, en"; camoufox worker "en-US, en" vs main "en-US" (observed 2026-09-21).
_findings.ua-version-vs-binary: chromium: UA claims Chrome 149 on a 151 binary (observed 2026-09-21; review finding 8).
_findings.persona-os-vs-host: chromium: claimed Windows, then Linux on a second run, on a macOS host. The persona is drawn per run, so this is intermittent on camoufox too — it claimed Windows on one run and macOS on the next (observed 2026-09-21). Listed because it fails on at least one draw.
